name: Edison International
description: Edison International is a holding company whose business is Southern California Edison (SCE), the electric utility serving about 5 million customers (5.39 million accounts) in a 50,000-square-mile area of southern California. California regulators decouple its authorised revenue from the volume sold, so SCE earns an allowed return (10.03% ROE for 2026 to 2028) on a rate base of $48.2 billion at year-end 2025 that the company plans to grow to about $68 billion by 2030. A small non-utility unit, Trio, advises commercial customers on energy. The overriding risk is wildfire liability: SCE has said a viable explanation for the January 2025 Eaton Fire is that its equipment ignited it, and it expects additional material losses it cannot yet estimate.

That list gives only Sector and Sub-Industry. SEC SIC code 4911 (Electric Services) per EDGAR.

employees.note: Edison International aggregate, excluding interns and employees on leave; 13,235 were full-time employees of SCE or its subsidiaries (FY2025 10-K). SCE also uses a large contract workforce.

businessLines.name: Southern California Edison (SCE)
businessLines.how: Customers pay CPUC- and FERC-approved rates every month; authorised revenue is decoupled from sales volume and power cost, so SCE earns an allowed return on rate base (distribution, transmission, generation) rather than on kilowatt-hours sold; wildfire-mitigation capex is also recovered with a return, with some excluded from the equity portion of rate base by state law.
businessLines.description: Regulated electric transmission, distribution and generation in southern California; 5,389 thousand customer accounts at Dec 31, 2025 (residential 4,672K, commercial 625K, industrial 4K, public authorities 70K, agricultural and other 18K).

operatingProfit.note: Net income available to Edison International (segment profit measure); FY2024 $1,619M. Includes a non-core gain of about $2,961M after tax from net recoveries on the 2017/2018 wildfire and mudslide events; core earnings $2,911M vs $2,232M (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/827052/000082705226000012/eix-20251231.htm)

businessLines.name: Edison International Parent and Other (includes Trio)
businessLines.how: Trio earns advisory and energy-services fees from commercial customers (immaterial); the rest is parent-company interest and preferred dividends that SCE's earnings must cover.
businessLines.description: Holding-company costs and financing, and Trio (Edison Energy, LLC), a global energy advisory firm for commercial, industrial and institutional customers.
